title: LF-Filter: Differentiated Processing for Intra-Flow Packet Delay Monitoring in High-Speed Data Streams

problem.claim: Monitoring inter-event delays in high-speed data streams, including intra-flow packet delay, is important for anomaly detection and temporal pattern discovery.

gap.claim: Existing intra-flow packet delay monitoring solutions have high collision rates and fixed temporal granularity, which limits detection accuracy.

narrative_sequence.summary: Inter-event delay monitoring is fundamental for anomaly detection and temporal pattern discovery in high-speed data streams.
Intra-flow packet delay is defined as the time interval between consecutive packets of the same flow.
Intra-flow packet delay supports detection of network anomalies such as low-rate DDoS attacks and port scans.
Existing solutions are limited by high collision rates and fixed temporal granularity, reducing detection accuracy.

unknowns: The proposed LF-Filter method is not described.
No experimental setup, datasets, baselines, quantitative results, or limitations are supplied.
No explicit novelty claim is supplied.
